[2] General manager Nina Cruz said that bookings for the first month are already 80 percent full. The resort has also introduced environmentally [3] practices, such as solar heating and a ban on single-use plastics. [4] opening week, guests will receive a complimentary dinner for two.

questions.explanation: The past tense fits a project that is completed.

choices: The island is reached by ferry from the mainland.
The airport will close for repairs next year.
Oil prices fell sharply last week.
Demand has been strong since the reopening date was announced in September.
questions.explanation: The sentence introduces the topic of bookings that the manager then comments on.
'Environmentally friendly' is an adjective phrase before 'practices'.
'During' is followed by a period of time.

text:
MEMO
To: All employees
From: Security Office
Subject: New identification badges

New photo identification badges will be issued next week. [1] Employees must collect their badges in person from the Security Office, [2] is open from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Please bring your old badge, which will be [3]. The new badges will give access only to the areas related to each employee's job. Anyone who loses a badge should [4] it immediately to the Security Office.

choices: The cafeteria will serve breakfast daily.
The current badges will stop working on Friday, May 9.
New parking lines are being painted.
The annual picnic will be held in August.
questions.explanation: The sentence states a consequence of the change and precedes the collection instructions.
'Which' introduces a non-restrictive clause about the Security Office.
The passive 'will be collected' is needed.
One 'reports' a lost badge, meaning one tells the office about it.

text:

questions.explanation: The passive 'will be reduced' is needed for prices.

questions.explanation: The sentence extends the offer, and the next sentence begins with 'also'.

'Once the sale ends' means 'as soon as it ends'.

text:

questions.explanation: Students 'learn' how to do something; teachers 'teach'.

choices: The classroom is located on the second floor.
The library lends books for three weeks.
Tuition fees will rise next year.
Each session combines a short lecture with group practice.
questions.explanation: The sentence describes how the course works and precedes what is expected of participants.
'Inclusive of' means that the price covers the items.
After 'must', the base form is used.

text:

questions.explanation: An adjective is needed after 'was'.

choices: The hotel has a pool on the roof.

questions.explanation: The sentence explains the value of the survey, before its length is given.
The passive 'will be entered' is needed.
The two events are added to each other: the draw is held and the winner is notified.
